scenarios.title: Credential leak
scenarios.trigger: A supported credential is suspected exposed or observed outside its approved custody boundary.
detection: record source and timestamp without copying secret values
identify affected credential class and scope
containment: revoke or rotate affected authority through approved operator path
quarantine in-flight work whose authority cannot be proven
evidence_preservation: retain redacted audit/event records before rotation
retain exact software/environment identity and affected principal scope
recovery: issue replacement credential using approved custody path
prove old authority is rejected before resuming affected work
forbidden_actions: do not publish secret material in evidence
do not declare recovered until old authority rejection is proven
exit_criteria: no unresolved credential exposure path remains

scenarios.title: Database corruption
scenarios.trigger: SQLite page/WAL/schema corruption, integrity failure, or unexpected unreadable durable state is detected.
detection: stop interpreting corrupted state as authoritative
capture error classification and exact database/runtime identity
containment: prevent unsafe network/external-effect actions from corrupted state
evidence_preservation: retain original database/WAL bytes read-only before repair attempts
recovery: restore only from verified backup/recovery point
forbidden_actions: do not overwrite the sole corrupted copy
do not infer successful recovery from service start alone

scenarios.title: Runaway work or resource exhaustion
scenarios.trigger: Work exceeds approved budget, cancellation bound, or materially degrades host/service resources.
detection: capture task/work identifiers and resource symptoms
distinguish provider/runtime/host exhaustion when evidence permits
containment: pause or drain through authenticated operator control
quarantine work that cannot be safely cancelled
evidence_preservation: retain first failure and resource measurements
recovery: resume only work whose authority and budget remain valid
forbidden_actions: do not increase limits solely to make the failing case pass
exit_criteria: resource use returns within declared envelope

scenarios.title: Host compromise
scenarios.trigger: A supported host is suspected compromised or its runtime/credential integrity cannot be established.
detection: record compromise indicators without executing untrusted payloads
identify host, software revision, credential scopes, and connected authorities
containment: revoke host/worker authority using approved operator control
evidence_preservation: preserve forensic image/log references according to policy
retain authority revocation and topology-change receipts
recovery: rebuild from approved immutable artifacts on a clean supported host
re-enroll with new authority only after verification
forbidden_actions: do not reuse credentials from a compromised host
do not trust recovered host solely because service starts

scenarios.title: Evidence integrity or confidentiality breach
scenarios.trigger: Release/qualification evidence is missing, tampered, unexpectedly exposed, or no longer independently verifiable.
detection: identify affected evidence scope and downstream claims
containment: freeze promotion/release decisions dependent on affected evidence
quarantine suspect evidence from authoritative sets
evidence_preservation: retain suspect bytes and verification failures
retain last independently verified manifest/provenance anchors
recovery: recompute evidence from direct authoritative sources where possible
requalify affected gates when source authority is insufficient
forbidden_actions: do not regenerate evidence and present it as the original
do not promote UNKNOWN or incomplete evidence to PASS
exit_criteria: affected claims have authoritative evidence or explicit UNKNOWN/BLOCKED status
release decisions are rebound to verified evidence
